name: review-coordinator-stale-check
title: Review coordinator replays a stale sd-check failure remediated outside the content digest
description: sd-review caches the typed sd-check result in coordinator state keyed on an identity that excludes --attempt, so a check failure remediated outside tracked content — the Obsidian KB refresh — replays forever and no documented argument reaches a live re-run. Third recurrence; previously misdiagnosed as an environment isolation artifact.
creator: sdelmas
notes: 2026-08-15: UNBLOCKED and resolved without a local code change. The upstream fix (08-07-review-check-stale-cache) landed and reached this repository in the 0.71.1 pack refresh (49f65dc). scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review.py:1931 now recomputes the deterministic check unconditionally and :1943 persists it only on a pass, which is the upstream recompute contract. Both planned local deliverables were checked and dropped with reason: the contract test would duplicate upstream coverage in ../sd-ai-command-pack/tests/test_review_controller.py of a file this repository cannot edit, and the vendored-path ownership convention is already captured in .trellis/spec/backend/directory-structure.md:143-186. design.md and implement.md remain a recorded refuted alternative and were never implemented. Prior park note (2026-08-09) retained in prd.md for history.
